summary: Environment A build/test evidence for the Wrong-Verse Feedback Loop: a rejected Paraphrase/Semantic suggestion's own reference, when independently redetected again within the existing dedup window, now increments an observable rejection_echo_count instead of vanishing with zero trace.
designChoice: The operator was asked to choose between (1) a silent echo counter - keep suppressing the repeat exactly as today, but record that it happened - and (2) re-surfacing a new, dampened suggestion each time. The operator chose (1), with an explicit flow: detection -> same reference+category -> was it rejected within the window? -> silently suppress + increment rejection echo counter + record diagnostic information. This evidence file covers the implementation of exactly that flow.
auditFinding: Before this phase, reject_suggestion only flipped SuggestionStatus to Rejected with zero downstream effect anywhere in the codebase. Because the dedup window checks scripture_detections (not suggestion status) and Phase 5.2's confirm_suggestion path only looks up Pending suggestions, a same-category repeat of an already-rejected reference within the 60s window was silently dropped with no trace at all - not unique to Rejected (Approved/Edited have the same gap), but the one case that actually matters since it discards the operator's explicit correction with no record.

newCode.coreAiSuggestion: core/ai/src/suggestion.rs: Suggestion.rejection_echo_count: u32, always 0 at construction, mirroring confirmation_count's own discipline.
newCode.persistence: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/persistence.rs: find_rejected_suggestion_for_reference (mirrors find_pending_suggestion_for_reference, filtered to Rejected instead of Pending) and record_rejection_echo (increments rejection_echo_count unconditionally, never touches status/confidence/kind). persist_suggestion/get_suggestion/list_suggestions/update_suggestion_status extended for the new column.
newCode.pipeline: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline.rs: handle_final_transcript_inner's dedup-suppression branch, when no Pending suggestion exists for a Paraphrase/Semantic repeat, now falls back to a rejection-echo lookup and increments the echo count on the most recent Rejected suggestion for that reference. Dedup's own suppression (the continue) is completely unchanged.
newCode.serviceReport: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/service_report.rs: SuggestionStats gained rejection_echoes: u64 (sum of every suggestion's rejection_echo_count for the service) - the 'diagnostic information' step of the operator's chosen flow, surfaced through the existing Phase 5.1 Service Report aggregation.
newCode.frontend: apps/desktop/src/domain/ai.ts Suggestion.rejectionEchoCount; apps/desktop/src/domain/service.ts SuggestionStats.rejectionEchoes; apps/desktop/src/components/library/HistoryView.tsx shows a rejection-echoes clause in the Service Report panel and an 'echoed ×N' suffix next to a rejected suggestion's status in the Scripture & Findings list, both only when nonzero.

architecturalSafetyNotes: Dedup's own suppression behavior is completely unchanged - a Paraphrase/Semantic repeat after a rejection is still silently absorbed, never creating a second suggestion.
record_rejection_echo never changes a suggestion's status, confidence, or kind - verified by a dedicated test asserting the score and status are byte-identical before and after recording an echo.
Approved/Edited suggestions are unaffected - the rejection-echo lookup only fires when the most recent suggestion for a reference is specifically Rejected.
